description: This Java source file defines the PortalPageWorker class, which provides methods for rendering portal pages, retrieving portal pages and specific portal page details, and checking user permissions related to portal page configuration within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PortalPageWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for managing portal pages, including rendering, retrieval, and permission checks.

methods.name: renderPortalPageAsTextExt
methods.description: Stub method intended to render a portal page as a text string; currently returns 'success'.

methods.name: getPortalPages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of portal pages with the specified parent ID, considering user-specific private pages if a user is logged in.

methods.name: getPortalPage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific portal page by ID, prioritizing user-specific private pages if they exist.

methods.name: userIsAllowedToConfigure
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to configure a portal page, based on ownership or admin permissions.
